clips.title: The story
paras: In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints are coveted by goblin rivals. They hold the technical schematics for an enormous mechanized woodcutter deployed in Stonetalon Mountains, designed under gnome engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s supervision.

Venture Company operators carry the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints through Windshear Crag. The plans show how to build the massive mechanized lumber harvesters driving the company’s relentless clear-cutting. To the dismay of traditional goblin engineers, the Venture Company put Gerenzo, a gnome, in charge of designing the model. When goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks was ousted from the operation, Sputtervalve quickly hired him to steal the designs. Yet Gerenzo’s dense, eccentric gnomish notations are almost as hard to decipher as the plans are to take by force.
